text:
Type: white box picture frame with mat
Use: framing photos, posters or art prints for a wall, a shelf or a desk; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: white painted frame with a deep flat profile, off-white mat, clear front panel, back stand
Colors: white, warm off-white mat
Shape: rectangular frame with deep box sides, a broad mat border that centers the picture, stands upright on a back leg or hangs, clean and simple
Feel: clean, bright, orderly, calm
Goes with: gallery walls, picture ledges, light wood, white walls, monochrome prints; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: RIBBA
product.description: Can be used hanging or standing, both horizontally and vertically, to fit in the space available.
